sharedBoundary: These are Codex-authored evaluation lenses informed by records Jamie supplied. A passing result is not a fresh review, testimonial, or approval by either professor. Protected academic records and private correspondence stay outside the public repository; public composition relies on public-safe claims and sources.

lenses.name: Prof. Margaret Morse lens
lenses.criterion: The portfolio preserves one clear threshold where Jamie's artistic, civic, technical, and social practices remain connected through participation, attention, hospitality, memory, place, and the ways people inhabit structures.
lenses.failureMode: The portfolio reduces Jamie to organizational utility and removes the artistic and embodied inquiry that distinguishes how he builds systems.
sourceBasis: Protected UCSC narrative-evaluation records reviewed but not reproduced

lenses.name: Prof. Warren Sack lens
lenses.criterion: The portfolio makes Jamie visible as an original social-technical thinker who finds patterns connecting people, information, and place, then tests them through interfaces, workflows, prototypes, and inhabited systems.
lenses.failureMode: The portfolio presents Jamie only as an implementer of settled requirements and obscures his capacity to frame research-quality questions and prototype social systems.
